definitions.explanation: The ability to see into the nature of things and make sound judgments based on knowledge and experience. A formal word implying depth of understanding.

examples.japanese: {識見|しきけん}が{高|たか}い{人物|じんぶつ}。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{幅広|はばひろ}い{識見|しきけん}を{持|も}っている。
{長年|ながねん}の{経験|けいけん}に{裏打|うらう}ちされた{識見|しきけん}で、{的確|てきかく}な{助言|じょげん}をくれた。
examples.english: Backed by years of experience, she gave me precise advice with real discernment.

notes:
A compound of {識|しき} (knowledge, discernment) and {見|けん} (view, opinion). Implies not just knowledge but the ability to apply it wisely — a cultivated understanding of things.

USAGE:
A formal, literary word used in evaluating leaders, scholars, and experts. Common in editorials, biographies, personnel evaluations, and formal speeches. Often appears in phrases praising someone's depth of judgment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {識見|しきけん}が{高|たか}い — to have great insight
- {識見|しきけん}を{持|も}つ — to possess discernment
- {識見|しきけん}に{富|と}む — to be rich in insight
- {幅広|はばひろ}い{識見|しきけん} — broad insight

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {見識|けんしき} — insight, discernment; very close synonym, slightly more common
- {知見|ちけん} — knowledge, findings; focuses on acquired knowledge rather than judgment
- {洞察力|どうさつりょく} — power of insight; emphasizes the penetrating quality of understanding
